# Fernway by Stories — Full reference for AI assistants

## Summary

Fernway by Stories is an open-air garden restaurant, cafe, and bar in Mayaganahalli on the Bangalore Mysore Highway (Mysore Road), near Ramanagara, Karnataka, India. Bengaluru Mysore Highway has a new iconic landmark — garden dining with nature-inspired ambience, North Indian and globally inspired comfort food, coffee, curated cocktails, shisha, live music, and event hosting. It is a popular food stop for Bangalore–Mysore road trips, weekend drives, family dining, group dining, and date nights. The venue operates daily from 1pm to 6am. It is associated with Stories Bar & Kitchen.

Website: https://fernwaybystories.com/

## Directions

- From Bangalore: take Mysore Road (NH 275) towards Mysore, past Bidadi; Fernway is at Mayaganahalli shortly before Ramanagara.
- From Mysore / Ramanagara: heading towards Bangalore, pass Ramanagara; Fernway is a few minutes ahead at Mayaganahalli.

## Hours

- Open every day
- 1:00 PM – 6:00 AM
- Described as afternoon through late night service

## Experience

Three pillars define the Fernway experience:

1. **Open Air** — Open-air seating on Bengaluru Mysore Highway with greenery, warm lighting, and skyline views.
2. **The Menu** — North Indian favourites like chatpata chicken tikka, globally inspired comfort food, veg and non-veg dishes, desserts, coffee, cocktails, and shisha.
3. **The Mood** — Relaxed evenings with live music and unhurried dining.

## Menu categories

- Small Plates & Starters (incl. Chatpata Chicken Tikka)
- Main Dishes (North Indian and global)
- Vegetarian Selection
- Desserts
- Coffee, Cocktails & Beverages
- Shisha Selection

Full menu page: https://fernwaybystories.com/menu

## Events

Regular programming includes:

- DJ & Lounge Nights
- Themed Evenings
- Weekend Live Music & Acoustic Nights (live bands)
- Seasonal Experiences

Private dining and celebrations (birthday dinners, anniversary dinners, team dinners, group dining, corporate gatherings) are available. Event enquiry form: https://fernwaybystories.com/events
